findings.title: Possible nil dereference of r.control in deferred menu closures
findings.message: The closure posted by queueMenuAction dereferences r.control.menu before any nil check. menuAvailable itself checks `r.control == nil`, which suggests control can be nil by the time posted work runs, for example after the record is retired or unmounted. In that case this panics on the owner/control queue. The posted closures in menuItem.Destroy and menuItem.Render have the same unguarded access to p.owner.control.
findings.suggestion: Guard against r.control == nil and r.control.menu == nil at the top of every deferred closure (queueMenuAction, menuItem.Destroy, menuItem.Render) before dereferencing.

fix.after: if r.control == nil || r.control.menu == nil || r.control.menu.popup != p || r.control.menu.epoch != p.epoch || !menuAvailable(r) {
